issue.title: whitespace-slug
issue.body: slugify should trim outer whitespace and collapse repeated whitespace into one hyphen.

classification.summary: slugify should trim outer whitespace and collapse repeated whitespace into one hyphen.

diff:
--- a/slugger.py
+++ b/slugger.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def slugify(text):
-    return text.lower().replace(' ', '-')
+    return '-'.join(text.lower().split())
